Khamoshi taqat hai.
Grit wahi hai jab raasta gaayab ho jaye, tab bhi raaste par tikna.
Lambi daud ke liye junoon aur mehnat hi grit hai.
Himmat na chillana—bas khade rehna.
Agar fast jaana hai, akelay jao. Agar door jaana hai, saath jao.
Kriya darr ko theek karti.
Jo control mein hai usi pe focus karna.
Grit ye jaan'na hai ki tum sangharsh me akelay nahi ho.
Aur silence nahi chahiye—zyada courage chahiye.
Jab chhodna ho, tab bhi chalte raho.
Himmat fear ke upar bridge hai.
New horizons ke liye shore ka nazar hatane ka courage chahiye.
Khamoshi wo reveal karti jo words chhupaate.
Himmat aatma hai.
Himmat contagious kindness hai.
Tum wahi karo jo tum sochte ho ki tum nahi kar sakte.
Pressure mein bhi grace—bravery.
Grit matlab lagatar peecha karna hai.
